data.narrative:
Kula Bio is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $86.7M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comp universe of nine private companies and one public entity (277810.KQ) at similar or adjacent stages, including Humanoid, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, Generalist AI, and Walden Robotics.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses the $87M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, yielding $173M. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Humanoid ($1.4B, Series A), Dexterity ($1.6B, Series B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B, Series B), Generalist AI ($2.0B, Series B), and Walden Robotics ($1.1B, Seed)—produces a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range of $1.1B to $2.0B.

The triangulated valuation range spans $147M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $912M. The wide dispersion reflects meaningful uncertainty regarding Kula's positioning within the peer set: stage-progression methodology suggests lower valuations aligned with early-stage capital deployment, while peer-median approaches imply substantially higher valuations driven by late-stage comparable multiples. Key variables include the company's technical differentiation, capital efficiency relative to peers, and market timing. A post-Series A valuation of $400M–$800M would reconcile stage-appropriate advancement with peer-relative positioning.
